verses.en: Peter, an apostle of Jesus Christ, to the strangers scattered throughout Pontus, Galatia, Cappadocia, Asia, and Bithynia,
verses.pt: Pedro, apóstolo de Jesus Cristo, aos peregrinos da Dispersão no Ponto, Galácia, Capadócia, Ásia e Bitínia.
verses.en_web: Peter, an apostle of Jesus Christ, to the chosen ones who are living as foreigners in the Dispersion in Pontus, Galatia, Cappadocia, Asia, and Bithynia,
verses.en_bbe: Peter, an Apostle of Jesus Christ, to the saints who are living in Pontus, Galatia, Cappadocia, Asia, and Bithynia,

verses.en: Elect according to the foreknowledge of God the Father, through sanctification of the Spirit, unto obedience and sprinkling of the blood of Jesus Christ: Grace unto you, and peace, be multiplied.
verses.pt: eleitos segundo a presciência de Deus Pai, na santificação do Espírito, para a obediência e aspersão do sangue de Jesus Cristo: Graça e paz vos sejam multiplicadas.
verses.en_web: according to the foreknowledge of God the Father, in sanctification of the Spirit, that you may obey Jesus Christ and be sprinkled with his blood: Grace to you and peace be multiplied.
verses.en_bbe: Who, through the purpose of God, have been made holy by the Spirit, disciples of Jesus, made clean by his blood: May you have grace and peace in full measure.

verses.en: Blessed be the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, which according to his abundant mercy hath begotten us again unto a lively hope by the resurrection of Jesus Christ from the dead,
verses.pt: Bendito seja o Deus e Pai de nosso Senhor Jesus Cristo, que, segundo a sua grande misericórdia, nos regenerou para uma viva esperança, pela ressurreição de Jesus Cristo dentre os mortos,
verses.en_web: Blessed be the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, who according to his great mercy caused us to be born again to a living hope through the resurrection of Jesus Christ from the dead,
verses.en_bbe: Praise be to the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, who through his great mercy has given us a new birth and a living hope by the coming again of Jesus Christ from the dead,

verses.en: To an inheritance incorruptible, and undefiled, and that fadeth not away, reserved in heaven for you,
verses.pt: para uma herança incorruptível, incontaminável e imarcescível, reservada nos céus para vós,
verses.en_web: to an incorruptible and undefiled inheritance that doesn’t fade away, reserved in Heaven for you,
verses.en_bbe: And a heritage fair, holy and for ever new, waiting in heaven for you,

verses.en: Who are kept by the power of God through faith unto salvation ready to be revealed in the last time.
verses.pt: que pelo poder de Deus sois guardados, mediante a fé, para a salvação que está preparada para se revelar no último tempo;
verses.en_web: who by the power of God are guarded through faith for a salvation ready to be revealed in the last time.
verses.en_bbe: Who, by the power of God are kept, through faith, for that salvation, which will be seen at the last day.

verses.en: Wherein ye greatly rejoice, though now for a season, if need be, ye are in heaviness through manifold temptations:
verses.pt: na qual exultais, ainda que agora por um pouco de tempo, sendo necessário, estejais contristados por várias provações,
verses.en_web: Wherein you greatly rejoice, though now for a little while, if need be, you have been put to grief in various trials,
verses.en_bbe: You have cause for great joy in this, though it may have been necessary for you to be troubled for a little time, being tested in all sorts of ways,

verses.en: That the trial of your faith, being much more precious than of gold that perisheth, though it be tried with fire, might be found unto praise and honour and glory at the appearing of Jesus Christ:
verses.pt: para que a prova da vossa fé, mais preciosa do que o ouro que perece, embora provado pelo fogo, redunde para louvor, glória e honra na revelação de Jesus Cristo;
verses.en_web: that the proof of your faith, which is more precious than gold that perishes even though it is tested by fire, may be found to result in praise, glory, and honor at the revelation of Jesus Christ—
verses.en_bbe: So that the true metal of your faith, being of much greater value than gold (which, though it comes to an end, is tested by fire), may come to light in praise and glory and honour, at the revelation of Jesus Christ:

verses.en: Whom having not seen, ye love; in whom, though now ye see him not, yet believing, ye rejoice with joy unspeakable and full of glory:
verses.pt: a quem, sem o terdes visto, amais; no qual, sem agora o verdes, mas crendo, exultais com gozo inefável e cheio de glória,
verses.en_web: whom not having known you love; in whom, though now you don’t see him, yet believing, you rejoice greatly with joy unspeakable and full of glory—
verses.en_bbe: To whom your love is given, though you have not seen him; and the faith which you have in him, though you do not see him now, gives you joy greater than words and full of glory:

verses.en: Receiving the end of your faith, even the salvation of your souls.
verses.pt: alcançando o fim da vossa fé, a salvação das vossas almas.
verses.en_web: receiving the result of your faith, the salvation of your souls.
verses.en_bbe: For so you have the true end of your faith, even the salvation of your souls.

verses.en: Of which salvation the prophets have enquired and searched diligently, who prophesied of the grace that should come unto you:
verses.pt: Desta salvação inquiririam e indagaram diligentemente os profetas que profetizaram da graça que para vós era destinada,
verses.en_web: Concerning this salvation, the prophets sought and searched diligently, who prophesied of the grace that would come to you,
verses.en_bbe: For the prophets who gave the news of the grace which would come to you, made search with all care for knowledge of this salvation;

verses.en: Searching what, or what manner of time the Spirit of Christ which was in them did signify, when it testified beforehand the sufferings of Christ, and the glory that should follow.
verses.pt: indagando qual o tempo ou qual a ocasião que o Espírito de Cristo que estava neles indicava, ao predizer os sofrimentos que a Cristo haviam de vir, e a glória que se lhes havia de seguir.
verses.en_web: searching for who or what kind of time the Spirit of Christ, which was in them, pointed to, when he predicted the sufferings of Christ, and the glories that would follow them.
verses.en_bbe: Attempting to see what sort of time the Spirit of Christ which was in them was pointing to, when it gave witness to the pains which Christ would undergo and the glories which would come after them.

verses.en: Unto whom it was revealed, that not unto themselves, but unto us they did minister the things, which are now reported unto you by them that have preached the gospel unto you with the Holy Ghost sent down from heaven; which things the angels desire to look into.
verses.pt: Aos quais foi revelado que não para si mesmos, mas para vós, eles ministravam estas coisas que agora vos foram anunciadas por aqueles que, pelo Espírito Santo enviado do céu, vos pregaram o evangelho; para as quais coisas os anjos bem desejam atentar.
verses.en_web: To them it was revealed, that not to themselves, but to you, they ministered these things, which now have been announced to you through those who preached the Good News to you by the Holy Spirit sent out from heaven; which things angels desire to look into.
verses.en_bbe: And it was made clear to those prophets that they were God's servants not for themselves but for you, to give you word of the things which have now come to your ears from the preachers of the good news through the Holy Spirit sent down from heaven; things which even angels have a desire to see.

verses.en: Wherefore gird up the loins of your mind, be sober, and hope to the end for the grace that is to be brought unto you at the revelation of Jesus Christ;
verses.pt: Portanto, cingindo os lombos do vosso entendimento, sede sóbrios, e esperai inteiramente na graça que se vos oferece na revelação de Jesus Cristo.
verses.en_web: Therefore prepare your minds for action, be sober, and set your hope fully on the grace that will be brought to you at the revelation of Jesus Christ—
verses.en_bbe: So make your minds ready, and keep on the watch, hoping with all your power for the grace which is to come to you at the revelation of Jesus Christ;

verses.en: As obedient children, not fashioning yourselves according to the former lusts in your ignorance:
verses.pt: Como filhos obedientes, não vos conformeis às concupiscências que antes tínheis na vossa ignorância;
verses.en_web: as children of obedience, not conforming yourselves according to your former lusts as in your ignorance,
verses.en_bbe: Like children ruled by God, do not go back to the old desires of the time when you were without knowledge:

verses.en: But as he which hath called you is holy, so be ye holy in all manner of conversation;
verses.pt: mas, como é santo aquele que vos chamou, sede vós também santos em todo o vosso procedimento;
verses.en_web: but just as he who called you is holy, you yourselves also be holy in all of your behavior;
verses.en_bbe: But be holy in every detail of your lives, as he, whose servants you are, is holy;

verses.en: Because it is written, Be ye holy; for I am holy.
verses.pt: porquanto está escrito: Sereis santos, porque eu sou santo.
verses.en_web: because it is written, “You shall be holy; for I am holy.”
verses.en_bbe: Because it has been said in the Writings, You are to be holy, for I am holy.

verses.en: And if ye call on the Father, who without respect of persons judgeth according to every man’s work, pass the time of your sojourning here in fear:
verses.pt: E, se invocais por Pai aquele que, sem acepção de pessoas, julga segundo a obra de cada um, andai em temor durante o tempo da vossa peregrinação,
verses.en_web: If you call on him as Father, who without respect of persons judges according to each man’s work, pass the time of your living as foreigners here in reverent fear:
verses.en_bbe: And if you give the name of Father to him who, judging every man by his acts, has no respect for a man's position, then go in fear while you are on this earth:

verses.en: Forasmuch as ye know that ye were not redeemed with corruptible things, as silver and gold, from your vain conversation received by tradition from your fathers;
verses.pt: sabendo que não foi com coisas corruptíveis, como prata ou ouro, que fostes resgatados da vossa vã maneira de viver, que por tradição recebestes dos vossos pais,
verses.en_web: knowing that you were redeemed, not with corruptible things, with silver or gold, from the useless way of life handed down from your fathers,
verses.en_bbe: Being conscious that you have been made free from that foolish way of life which was your heritage from your fathers, not through a payment of things like silver or gold which come to destruction,

verses.en: But with the precious blood of Christ, as of a lamb without blemish and without spot:
verses.pt: mas com precioso sangue, como de um cordeiro sem defeito e sem mancha, o sangue de Cristo,
verses.en_web: but with precious blood, as of a lamb without blemish or spot, the blood of Christ;
verses.en_bbe: But through holy blood, like that of a clean and unmarked lamb, even the blood of Christ:

verses.en: Who verily was foreordained before the foundation of the world, but was manifest in these last times for you,
verses.pt: o qual, na verdade, foi conhecido ainda antes da fundação do mundo, mas manifesto no fim dos tempos por amor de vós,
verses.en_web: who was foreknown indeed before the foundation of the world, but was revealed in this last age for your sake,
verses.en_bbe: Who was marked out by God before the making of the world, but was caused to be seen in these last times for you,

verses.en: Who by him do believe in God, that raised him up from the dead, and gave him glory; that your faith and hope might be in God.
verses.pt: que por ele credes em Deus, que o ressuscitou dentre os mortos e lhe deu glória, de modo que a vossa fé e esperança estivessem em Deus.
verses.en_web: who through him are believers in God, who raised him from the dead, and gave him glory; so that your faith and hope might be in God.
verses.en_bbe: Who through him have faith in God who took him up again from the dead into glory; so that your faith and hope might be in God.

verses.en: Seeing ye have purified your souls in obeying the truth through the Spirit unto unfeigned love of the brethren, see that ye love one another with a pure heart fervently:
verses.pt: Já que tendes purificado as vossas almas na obediência à verdade, que leva ao amor fraternal não fingido, de coração amai-vos ardentemente uns aos outros,
verses.en_web: Seeing you have purified your souls in your obedience to the truth through the Spirit in sincere brotherly affection, love one another from the heart fervently:
verses.en_bbe: And as you have made your souls clean, being ruled by what is true, and loving one another without deceit, see that your love is warm and from the heart:

verses.en: Being born again, not of corruptible seed, but of incorruptible, by the word of God, which liveth and abideth for ever.
verses.pt: tendo renascido, não de semente corruptível, mas de incorruptível, pela palavra de Deus, a qual vive e permanece.
verses.en_web: having been born again, not of corruptible seed, but of incorruptible, through the word of God, which lives and remains forever.
verses.en_bbe: Because you have had a new birth, not from the seed of man, but from eternal seed, through the word of a living and unchanging God.

verses.en: For all flesh is as grass, and all the glory of man as the flower of grass. The grass withereth, and the flower thereof falleth away:
verses.pt: Porque: Toda a carne é como a erva, e toda a sua glória como a flor da erva. Secou-se a erva, e caiu a sua flor;
verses.en_web: For, “All flesh is like grass, and all of man’s glory like the flower in the grass. The grass withers, and its flower falls;
verses.en_bbe: For it is said, All flesh is like grass, and all its glory like the flower of the grass. The grass becomes dry and the flower dead:

verses.en: But the word of the Lord endureth for ever. And this is the word which by the gospel is preached unto you.
verses.pt: mas a palavra do Senhor permanece para sempre. E esta é a palavra que vos foi evangelizada.
verses.en_web: but the Lord’s word endures forever.” This is the word of Good News which was preached to you.
verses.en_bbe: But the word of the Lord is eternal. And this is the word of the good news which was given to you.
